notes.title: "DuDu Kingdom" has now launched a pioneering experience.
notes.notes:
Dear friends and players, "DuDu Kingdom" has now launched a pioneering experience. We hope everyone can actively support and participate in the development of the game. We welcome feedback and suggestions, which will greatly support DuDu's growth! Thank you all!
